verdict.rationale: Supabase's dashboard ships an integrated AI Assistant that generates SQL, analyzes errors and suggests fixes, and gives "instant feedback and recommendations" tailored to the table you are working on, so in-product AI suggestions are clearly delivered. Schema-design guidance and dashboard Advisors (deterministic findings exposed alongside, also reachable by agents) add context-aware suggestions. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of AI-generated insights about data contents (trends, anomalies, summaries) rather than schema/SQL help, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the assistant's quality.
